Overview

About TIDE 2.0 Grant

TIDE 2.0 is a Ministry of Electronics and IT scheme that funds technology startups through a network of incubation centres at academic and R&D institutions. It supports ideas that use emerging technologies to solve problems in areas such as healthcare, education, agriculture, energy and financial inclusion.

Startups at the prototype stage can receive grant-in-aid of up to ₹7 Lakh, released against milestones, along with incubation, mentoring and access to labs and networks. The grant helps move an idea from prototype to a market-ready product.

Key benefits

  • Grant support of up to ₹7 Lakh, released on milestones
  • Takes the idea from prototype to market with incubator support
  • Mentorship from industry experts and domain mentors
  • National recognition that improves credibility with investors
  • Access to lab facilities and co-working space at the incubator

Who is eligible

  • Startups and MSMEs working on technology products
  • Student innovators and individual innovators
  • R&D institutions and academic teams with a product idea
  • Solutions using emerging technologies such as AI, IoT, blockchain, robotics or clean tech
  • Willingness to be incubated at a TIDE 2.0 centre

Documents required

  • Incorporation documents, or founder identity proof for individuals
  • Concept note with problem, solution and technology stack
  • Prototype details, demo or proof of concept
  • Milestone plan with budget and timeline
  • Team profiles and any IP filed
